title.narrative: Papua New Guinea COVID-19 Extension Project

description.narrative: The primary objective of this project is to provide the National Department of Health of Papua New Guinea and in turn health facilities across PNG with emergency medical supplies, laboratory equipment and consumables to reduce the spread of the COVID-19 virus. The availability of the key equipment will strengthen the ability of the PNG health system to effectively treat COVID-19 cases. \n
